## Summary
- Diagnostic Category: [`lint/nursery/useBigintLiterals`](/reference/diagnostics#diagnostic-category)
- This rule has a [**safe**](/linter/#safe-fixes) fix.
- The default severity of this rule is [**warning**](/reference/diagnostics#warning).
- Sources: 
  - Same as [`unicorn/prefer-bigint-literals`](https://github.com/sindresorhus/eslint-plugin-unicorn/blob/main/docs/rules/prefer-bigint-literals.md)

## How to configure
```json title="biome.json"
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"useBigintLiterals": "error"
			}
		}
	}
}

```
## Description
Enforce the use of bigint literals over the `BigInt()` constructor.

A bigint literal with the `n` suffix is more concise than calling `BigInt()`
with a number or string literal, and it is evaluated at parse time rather than
converted at runtime.

The rule only reports calls whose argument is a number or string literal that
can be expressed as a bigint literal. Calls with a computed argument are ignored.

## Examples

### Invalid

```js
const bigint = BigInt(1);
```

### Valid
